Autumn in the Key of Song: An Evening with Helen Welch and Friends @ BOP STOP

October 9 from 7:30pm - 9:30pm

Get ready for an unforgettable evening of music as international vocalist, entertainer, producer, and musician Helen Welch returns to Cleveland’s acclaimed Bop Stop for one night only on Friday October 9th at 7.30pm. Tickets for tonight are $30 (a $3 per ticket processing fee will be added to your purchase).
